name: Jelqing

lead: Jelqing is a manual technique in which a man strokes or squeezes a semi-erect penis from base toward the head, with the aim of increasing length or girth. It circulates in looksmaxxing forums under labels such as girthmaxxing and lengthmaxxing.

Many people report personal success online, but Wikipedia states that medical evidence is absent. The only peer-reviewed study in this entry's source set concerns men anxious about penis size and notes that they were more likely to attempt methods such as jelqing; it did not test whether jelqing works.

paras: Proponents describe the mechanism as repeated stretching that causes microscopic tears in erectile tissue which then heal larger. Some forum members counter that stretching enlarges existing erectile chambers without adding new ones, lowering tissue density. Neither account has been tested in clinical studies.

Clinicians cited by Wikipedia caution against routine or aggressive jelqing because of possible fibrosis and plaque formation, and the technique may raise the risk of hard flaccid syndrome. Penis size anxiety, which often motivates the practice, has been studied separately as a body dysmorphic concern.

lead: Jelqing is a manual technique that claims to enlarge the penis. Practitioners squeeze and stroke the semi-erect shaft from base toward the head. [1] The word is said to derive from the Persian phrase jalq zadan, and Wikipedia attributes the technique to ancient Arab origins. [1]

Many people describe personal gains in online communities, but Wikipedia states that medical evidence for the technique is absent and that journalists have called it biologically implausible. [1] Clinicians quoted there generally advise against routine jelqing and caution that aggressive manipulation may cause fibrosis and plaque formation or contribute to hard flaccid syndrome. [1]
In looksmaxxing communities, jelqing is discussed alongside other physical enlargement methods such as vacuum pumps and stretching devices, under terms such as girthmaxxing and lengthmaxxing. [2][3]
infobox: Fibrosis, plaque formation, hard flaccid syndrome [1]

paras: Jelqing is performed on the semi-erect penis by moving the hand from base to head in a repeated stroking or squeezing motion, with the stated goal of increasing size. [1] Forum discussions describe it as one of several physical enlargement routes alongside stretchers and pumps. [2]

A looksmax.org post argues that jelqing and other physical enlargement methods work by stretching erectile tissue to cause microtears that heal to increase volume. The same post argues that this enlarges existing erectile chambers rather than adding new ones, which it says would reduce erectile tissue density. [3] These are forum claims; no clinical study has tested the mechanism.

No studies found. A 2015 cohort study of 90 men compared men with body dysmorphic disorder concerning penis size, men with small penis anxiety, and controls. It found that men with either concern were more likely than controls to have attempted to change penis size or shape, for example by jelqing, vacuum pumps or stretching devices, and reported reduced sexual satisfaction measures in the dysmorphic group. It did not test whether jelqing changes size. [2]

Clinicians cited by Wikipedia caution against routine use, particularly aggressive manipulation, because of possible fibrosis and plaque formation, and say it may increase the risk of hard flaccid syndrome. [1]

Threads on looksmax.org range from instructional posts to warnings. One post titled as a warning argues jelqing leaves erectile tissue of lower density. [3] Community members also disagree about whether the practice has any lasting effect.

lore.intro: On looksmax.org, jelqing is discussed both as a size-increase method and as a practice some members warn against, with members disagreeing about whether any gain is permanent. [3]
